Terms & conditions

The Closetoskin web shop at closetoskin.com is operated by Sommerfugl Consult (org. no. 813 728 362). These terms govern the use of the web shop.

Privacy

Personal information you share with Closetoskin is used only to fulfil your order and give you the best service. We never share your details with third parties without your consent. You may request to see, correct or delete your information at any time by emailing info@closetoskin.com.

Orders

You'll receive an automatic email confirming your order. If an item turns out to be out of stock, we'll contact you and offer to cancel the order. Colours on screen may differ slightly from the actual product.

Prices & payment

Prices are stated in NOK including 25% Norwegian VAT and excluding shipping. Customers outside Norway shop tax-free and are responsible for local import duties and taxes. Prices are fixed at the time you place your order. Parcels returned because of unpaid customs charges are refunded minus any costs incurred.

Delivery

See Shipping & returns. Closetoskin does not cover shipping costs for uncollected packages.

Complaints

We welcome feedback. If you wish to complain, email info@closetoskin.com stating clearly that it's a complaint, and we'll respond within a few working days.
